answer.answer: These two studies are not independent, directly paired measurements of the same samples; they use different net/trawl methods, size cutoffs, and sampling locations/times around Australia-NZ, and no published dataset gives a sample-matched Reisser/Eriksen ratio. Without a shared-sample pairing, no median ratio can be computed from known literature.
